name: @w6w-apps/teamwork
description: Manage Teamwork projects, tasks, task lists, milestones and time logs.

w6w.longDescription:
Teamwork.com is a project management platform: projects, task lists, tasks, milestones and time tracking. This app covers the day-to-day work of running a project from a workflow — creating and updating projects, listing and managing tasks and the task lists that hold them, setting milestones, and logging or listing time against a task.

Every Teamwork account lives on its own subdomain (`{yourSiteName}.teamwork.com`), collected once at connect time rather than re-entered per action.

A fit for routing an external event into a new task or project, updating task status as a workflow progresses, logging time recorded elsewhere back into Teamwork, or syncing project and milestone data with another system.
